title: Foxxy's Dupable Sherds
description: A small datapack that allows you to duplicate pottery sherds with bricks
body:
# Info
### Version 1.1.0 is out now!
- Updated to more modern versions
- Recipes can be unlocked in the recipe book
- Grouped together Sherd recipes to declutter the recipe book
- Fixed some typos

### About this pack

This is a small datapack which adds the ability to duplicate Pottery Sherds using 4 bricks.


Pottery sherds are purely decorative and have a lot of potential for lore and story, which is held back by a lack of crafting recipe. This pack aims to ammend that without hindering the player requirement for adventure and exploration.


To duplicate a sherd, simply find the sherd of your choosing in the wild, grab 4 bricks, and head to a crafting table. Place the sherd in the middle and a brick on each side! It's that simple!


If you want a version with the ability to be able to craft Sherds as well, please take a look this datapack, which adds unique crafting recipes to each sherd, here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/foxxys-craftable-sherds
